subject: Post-call: HavenGen dedicated capacity qualification & SLA targets
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Tan <emily.tan@havengen.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + next steps (dedicated capacity)

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call so we have a shared view and clear next steps. If I missed anything, please flag and I’ll update.

High-level goals you shared
- Replace on-prem GPU fleet with dedicated, SLA-backed pool to reduce operational overhead and shorten model iteration cycles
- Achieve sub-70ms median tail latency for chat workloads at 1–3k qps (inference transactions/sec) during peak windows
- Maintain strict data separation for PII-sensitive traffic and have audit/logging available for compliance reviews

Primary pain points
- Current burst behavior on your EC2 fleet creates noisy neighbor latency spikes (10–25% of requests)
- Cost unpredictability when scaling for spikes; procurement wants fixed runway for Q2–Q3
- Security checklist items (SOC2 evidence, access controls) are gating procurement

Capacity & isolation needs we discussed
- Starting commitment: 8 x A100-equivalent GPU steady capacity, with 2x burst slots for scheduled spikes
- Tenant isolation: dedicated pool with network-level segmentation (VPC peering + private endpoints) and optional on-prem connector for air-gapped jobs
- Quantization/throughput plan: we’ll run a quick benchmark on your representative model (LLM-XL-13B) to estimate token/sec at INT8 vs FP16

SLA targets proposed
- 99.9% uptime SLA for dedicated pool
- 95th percentile p99.5 tail latency target under steady load; fallback policy to a compatible cheaper model if latency slips during spikes

Attachments & artifacts I’m sharing
- Attached: HavenGen-MAP-v1.xlsx — draft mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones and owners
- SOC2-evidence-outline.pdf — list of artifacts and timelines we can provide for procurement

Immediate next steps
1) Emily / procurement to confirm the procurement cadence and any internal approval dates by Fri 3/5
2) HavenGen to send a representative model binary or Docker image for a short benchmark run (Grace to own the test)
3) Redwood to share a rough cost estimate and a 12‑week onboarding timeline (Marissa will draft)

Would you be comfortable confirming the procurement target date this week? If so we’ll lock the MAP and get the benchmark scheduled for next week.

Thanks —
Aditya
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first LLM inference

From: Emily Tan <emily.tan@havengen.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jason Li <jason@havengen.ai>, procurement@havengen.ai, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Mar 2027 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps (dedicated capacity)

Thanks Aditya — solid notes, appreciate the clarity. Quick replies inline: 

- Procurement cadence: we need a vendor packet by 3/8; leadership review on 3/16. I’ll mark procurement@havengen.ai to prep the packet (Jason is our procurement lead).
- Model artifact: Jason will upload a Docker image with the LLM-XL-13B inference container to the shared S3 by EOD Thursday (3/4). Format: tar.gz with inference README.
- SLA: 99.9% is fine for initial contract; can we get a concrete definition for the p99.5 measurement window you’ll use? Procurement wants the drift/fallback triggers spelled out.

On security/compliance: we’ll need examples of the audit log format (to validate retention policy) and your KMS integration notes for encryption at rest. The SOC2 outline helps but we’ll need a short statement on data residency (all EU/US regions) — we prefer control plane metadata not stored outside the US.

Attachments: I’m attaching our internal vendor intake template (placeholder only).

Next steps for us
- Jason to upload model artifact by 3/4 (target)
- Procurement to assemble vendor packet by 3/8
- We’ll confirm internal leadership review date 3/16 (tentative)

I’ll confirm the procurement timeline in a follow-up once Jason confirms upload.

Best,
Emily
Head of Platform Engineering, HavenGen
Emily.Tan@havengen.ai

> On Tue, Mar 2, 2027 at 11:45 AM Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> > Thanks again for taking time today...

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Tan <emily.tan@havengen.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps (dedicated capacity) — benchmark plan

Hi Emily — looping in the benchmark plan and owners so we can move quickly once Jason uploads the image.

Planned benchmark steps (target completion: 3/11)
1) Ingest: pull Docker image from HavenGen S3 (Jason) and run smoke test to ensure container starts and model loads (Grace)
2) Latency profile: run 10k synthetic chat queries that mirror your 512-token typical session distribution; record p50/p95/p99/p99.5
3) Throughput: run sustained load tests to find the tokens/sec curve and best-effort packing/batching settings
4) Failure modes: simulate noisy-neighbor by running co-located background jobs and validate fallback to smaller model variant

Data handling notes
- For compliance, we’ll run benchmarks with synthetic data only; no customer PII will be used.
- Audit logs & KMS: Aditya will share the log schema and KMS integration steps in a separate doc (we’ll also include examples in the vendor packet).

I’ll own the benchmark execution and will send a readout for the team once complete. Marissa – I’ve added the MAP milestones you asked for to the shared spreadsheet (see attachment in Aditya’s message).

Thanks — looking forward to moving this through the procurement window.

Grace
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
snippet: Post-call recap: committed capacity, isolation, SLA targets and benchmark plan; Jason to upload model image by 3/4; procurement packet due 3/8.
